resources.string: Debug-only launcher for the normal text-composer Activity. It requires no Telegram login or target, and text is not sent or saved.

This measurement is independent of Telegram. Recognition text remains only in this screen memory and is not saved, logged, or shared. A standard system recognizer may send audio over the network. Do not call a run offline until it succeeds in airplane mode.
